title: cellranger_atac_count
description: Align fastq files using Cell Ranger ATAC count.

dataset input.title: Dataset input
dataset input.description: Dataset input using nf-tower "dataset" or "data explorer". Allows for the input of multiple parameter sets to initialise a Nextflow channel.

param_list.description: Dataset input can either be a list of maps, a csv file, a json file, a yaml file, or simply a yaml blob. The names of the input fields (e.g. csv columns, json keys) need to be an exact match with the workflow input parameters.

input.description: The fastq.gz files to align. Can also be a single directory containing fastq.gz files.
input.help_text: type: `array`, multiple: True, required, direction: `input`, example: `['sample_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz', 'sample_S1_L001_R2_001.fastq.gz']`

reference.description: The path to Cell Ranger reference tar.gz file. Can also be a directory.
reference.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `['reference.tar.gz']`

output.description: The folder to store the alignment results.
output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `['/path/to/output']`

description.description: Sample description to embed in output files

force_cells.description: Define the top N barcodes with the most fragments overlapping peaks as cells and override the cell calling algorithm. N must be a positive integer <= 20,000. Use this option if the number of cells estimated by Cell Ranger ATAC is not consistent with the barcode rank plot

peaks.description: Override peak caller: specify peaks to use in downstream analyses from supplied 3-column BED file. The supplied peaks file must be sorted by position and not contain overlapping peaks; comment lines beginning with # are allowed

subsample_rate.description: Downsample to preserve this fraction of reads

lanes.description: bcl2fastq option. Semicolon-delimited series of lanes to demultiplex. Use this if you have a sample sheet for an entire flow cell but only want to generate a few lanes for further 10x Genomics analysis.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
